channel.description: AI monitoring of Israel/Gaza, Iran, Syria, Lebanon and Iraq developments

item.title: Katz threatens all-out war on PA while IDF insists no concrete intelligence of attack
item.description: Asked whether the claim was manufactured, Katz told the Post that it was based on an IDF presentation to the cabinet on Monday concerning the military's need to prepare for extreme scenarios.

item.title: Hamas plotting October 7 attacks on IDF soldiers in Gaza, Israeli intelligence indicates
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz: Israel observed intent by Hamas to launch terror attacks on the anniversary of October 7, Hamas and Gazan population will pay "a heavy price beyond all proportion."

item.title: Iranian women trained with missiles, drones as regime seeks recruits for ‘self-sacrifice’ campaign
item.description: Iranian state media published images of women training in missile use, urban warfare, firearms, and drone operations as part of a new military training campaign.

item.title: 'See who the real enemy is': Israeli envoy Akunis invites Mamdani to view October 7 footage
item.description: Akunis extended the invitation to Mamdani during a memorial ceremony held by the Israeli Consulate in the city, attended by some 1,000 people, and simultaneously sent him a formal letter.

item.title: Israel was prepared to down flydubai flight with 166 Israelis onboard during attempted hijacking
item.description: Had flight 1073 continued toward Israel and reached a predetermined distance, Israeli fighter jets would have entered Jordanian airspace to investigate the aircraft, two sources told CBS News.

item.title: Wearable counter‑drone tech enters frontline service across US, Ukraine and IDF units
item.description: The wearable counter‑drone kit, deployed by Ukrainian troops and IDF forces and integrated into US Army exercises under EUCOM as top US commander warns troops will be ‘hunted’ by autonomous systems

item.title: As Brazil heads to run-off, Israel’s Latin America ties are placed in spotlight - analysis
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro’s first-round victory over Lula da Silva puts Brazil at the center of a broader political shift in Latin America that could strengthen ties with Israel.

item.title: Syrian president Sharaa arrives in Riyadh on official visit, SANA reports
item.description: Ahmed al-Sharaa arrived in the Saudi capital for an official visit, where he is expected to meet Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.

item.title: Who will teach the next generation?
item.description: A Jerusalem summit will bring together more than 300 educators from Israel and around the world to share ideas, confront common challenges, and strengthen the connections that sustain Jewish life.

item.title: No. 1: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump: Remembering who brought the hostages home
item.description: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump helped achieve what few in Jerusalem thought possible, bringing every Israeli hostage home and reshaping the Middle East.

item.title: No. 3: Gadi Eisenkot: Israel’s next prime minister?
item.description: The former IDF chief has emerged as the leading opposition challenger to Netanyahu, offering voters a path to a post-Netanyahu Israel.

item.title: No. 4: Naftali Bennett: The former PM seeking a comeback to ‘repair Israel’
item.description: Since returning to politics, Bennett has shifted from his previous campaigns, taking a more liberal position while maintaining a strong right-wing stance on security.

item.title: No. 5: Ronald Lauder: Standing at the forefront of the fight against antisemitism
item.description: Lauder has never confined himself to quiet philanthropy - he continues to use his position to demand accountability from political leaders.

item.title: No. 2: Benjamin Netanyahu: Shaping Israel’s politics and global image for a generation
item.description: Netanyahu has become more than Israel’s prime minister for many. Abroad, for instance, he has become Israel’s symbol and the lightning rod for much of the hatred directed against the Jewish state.

item.title: Rabbi Lando: Zionism to blame for Arab hostility, religious IDF troops killed over 'twisted Torah'
item.description: UTJ spiritual leader Lando: '[National-Religious Jews] are being killed because their rabbis teach them twisted Torah' • Litvak rabbi says secular Israelis 'have no connection with Judaism'

item.title: Government weighs NIS 9m. assistance after flydubai suspends Israel flights - analysis
item.description: The proposed mechanism would help cover empty outbound flights from Israel to Dubai and separate cargo flights carrying passengers’ baggage back to Israel.

item.title: Somaliland seeks deeper security ties with Israel, sees Turkey as growing threat
item.description: A senior Somaliland adviser said Hargeisa wants Israel to bolster its defenses against Turkey, pointing to Turkish fighter jets, drones and growing military cooperation with Somalia.

item.title: Israel 'in the dark' over flydubai terror hijacker investigation as Mossad probes link to Iran
item.description: "There is no information that can rule out or confirm an Iranian connection to or involvement with" Omani terrorist co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami, an Israeli official said.

item.title: Israel denies entry to 33 Chinese nationals using fake Japanese passports at Allenby Crossing
item.description: PIBA said 27 men and six women used legitimate Chinese passports in Jordan before presenting forged Japanese passports when attempting to cross into Israel.

item.title: ‘No way this is a malfunction’: Israeli officer reveals tense moments after flydubai hijack signal
item.description: Lt. N., an air force aerial image identification officer, was on duty at 8:30 a.m. when he detected the first distress signal from the flydubai flight to Tel Aviv.
